purpose: Teach: 検挙/記帳/投書/動議/募っ/危惧し/横ばい/雑多

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、警察、絶対、検挙、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're handling this case with the utmost seriousness. The police department is moving forward on the arrest with absolute commitment. We appreciate your partnership.
lines.style: Measured and formal, but warm underneath. Even pacing. A slight lean forward on 'utmost seriousness.' Professional but not cold — the tone of someone who takes the work seriously and wants the other person to know they're trusted.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様への、本気で、絶対、記帳、絶対、受付、絶対、当社、絶対、ご支援、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We'll ensure full cooperation with the police. Our records are open to you, and we're ready to support the investigation in any way we can. Thank you for your diligence.
lines.style: Respectful, engaged. Voice lifts slightly on the opening 'Yes' — active listening. Steady tempo. A hint of earnestness: this isn't mere protocol compliance, it's genuine willingness to help.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 市民からの、本気で、絶対、投書、絶対、警察、絶対、真摯に、絶対、対応しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We take citizen reports very seriously. Each one is reviewed carefully, and we respond with the attention it deserves.
lines.style: Composed, deliberate. Slight pause after the opening phrase. Clear articulation on 'reviewed carefully' — conviction without defensiveness. The tone of institutional care.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域協議会の、本気で、絶対、動議、絶対、警察様、絶対、ご対応、絶対、お願いいたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our community council has raised concerns, and we're committed to working closely with you on this. We appreciate your responsiveness to the issues that matter to us.
lines.style: Earnest, collaborative. Voice steadies on 'committed' — that's the key word. Mid-range warmth: not effusive, but genuinely present. A small nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気for、絶対、優秀な人材を、絶対、募って、絶対、おります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Our recruitment efforts are focused on bringing in the finest candidates. We're building the team we need to handle what's ahead.
lines.style: Steady and purposeful. Slight emphasis on 'finest candidates' — pride without boasting. Mid-pace, confident. The tone of someone talking about work they believe in.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、犯罪増加、絶対、危惧して、絶対、警察様と、絶対、連携、絶対、強化しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're concerned about rising crime in our area, and that's why strengthening our partnership with you is so important to us. We're grateful for your commitment.
lines.style: Direct, earnest. Voice deepens slightly on 'concerned' — real worry, not performative. Then lifts on 'partnership' — hope. Even pace, but with weight behind the words.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 検挙率が、本気で、絶対、横ばい、絶対、では、絶対、足りない、絶対、強化しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Arrest rates alone aren't the measure. We need to see real improvement, and that means we can't settle for where we are now. We're pushing for better results across the board.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Clear attack on 'aren't.' A slight edge of determination, but professional — this is accountability speaking. Pace steady and unflinching.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様からの、本気で、絶対、雑多、絶対、な、絶対、ご相談、絶対、当社、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、対応しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We welcome the chance to handle your inquiries with care. Whatever comes up — large or small — we're here to help thoroughly and professionally. We're honored by your trust.
lines.style: Warm closing tone. Voice gentles slightly. Open and receptive — almost conversational, but still formal. A sense of closure with genuine gratitude underneath.
